question: reply
description: Does a prospect's reply show genuine interest? Asked through AIGenerator.classify_reply_intent, in the agent only about replies its wording rules could not decide; a YES raises an interest alert. Every company, person and address here is invented, and every domain ends in .example. The replies are written as real ones look: short, with greetings, signatures and the odd typo, mostly in Italian and English, then German, French and Spanish, and a few in Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Swedish and Greek. Each is worded so the wording rules leave it to the AI, as the agent would, and --check shows none is settled by them. None is one the agent's inbox files away before that judgement, as it does an auto-reply whose subject says so ('Automatic reply', 'Fuori sede') and a delivery failure: the out-of-office replies here come back as 'Re:' with the original subject, as those that reach the AI do. Several clear NO replies ask a question, so that asking something is not by itself interest. Some pairs share the same polite opening and then turn once to buying and once to a decline, so the opening alone decides nothing.
